mapper.insert: INSERT INTO category (category_id, name, created_at) VALUES (UUID_TO_BIN(#{categoryId}), #{name}, #{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name)
mapper.select: SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(category_id) AS category_id, name, created_at FROM category WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(category_id) AS category_id, name, created_at FROM category
SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(category_id) AS category_id, name, created_at FROM category WHERE category_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{categoryId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM category WHERE category_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{categoryId})
